issue: On 28 May 2026 TNPA signed a 25-year terminal operator agreement with Ukwanda LNG (Tamasa Energy Group + Strategic Fuel Fund JV) for a R22bn (~$1.34-1.35bn) LNG project at the Port of Ngqura, with a ~36-month construction period and full operationalisation targeted 2035; TNPA is concurrently building a dedicated ~R2bn LNG berth. GEM status is 'proposed'. This is a major de-risking milestone; once berth/terminal construction physically begins the status should likely advance to 'construction'. No confirmation that civil works have started yet.
suggested_action: Monitor for construction start; if/when berth or terminal civil works begin, advance Status proposed->construction (timeline edit). fetch_timeline endpoint is DOWN, so route any status/timeline change through QA rather than a staged Status edit.

issue: OriginalPlannedStartYear=2029 could not be corroborated off-GEM. Independent sources give varying start years: early lngprime coverage targeted COD ~2027; easterncapeindustrialnews said the LNG berth would complete by 2028/9 with the terminal 'operational not long after'; the May-2026 deal coverage now targets full operationalisation by 2035. None states 2029 as the ORIGINAL planned start. (LatestPlannedStartYear was updated to 2035 in the updates file.)
suggested_action: Reviewer to decide whether OriginalPlannedStartYear should stay 2029 (no clean source), revert to ~2027 (earliest published target), or be left as-is. Not staged because no off-GEM source explicitly supports 2029.

issue: Phase 1 FID has slipped from 2026 to 2028 (LNG Prime, 5 Jun 2026: 'Vopak and Transnet Pipelines plan to take a final investment decision on this phase in 2028'), reportedly linked to delays in Eskom's 3,000 MW Richards Bay gas-to-power programme (Sept 2025 SCA setting aside Eskom's environmental authorisation). FIDYear updated to 2028 (staged). Consequently the Phase 1 COD (currently 2028) and Phase 2 COD (2030) are very likely to slip too, though no specific revised first-gas years are published yet. Status remains 'proposed' (no construction).
suggested_action: Monitor for revised Phase 1/Phase 2 COD years after FID (now 2028); update LatestPlannedStartYear once a developer/regulator figure is published. Status stays proposed until FID/construction.

issue: Phase 1 OriginalPlannedStartYear=2026 is not supported by current sources, which give the original Phase 1 COD as ~2027 (Reuters/economictimes: 'import 2 mtpa of LNG by 2027') or 2028 (lngprime 140944).
